description: Self-update: check/download/install a signed release, then relaunch. Scoped to the REPOSITORY windows ("main" and the "pg-*" siblings #256 adds) and never to the merge resolver window (label "merge"), which has no business swapping the binary out from under an in-progress conflict resolution, let alone restarting the process. A sibling repository window IS the whole app — it carries the same update chip and panel — so leaving it out would have shipped an Install button that fails with a permission error, and would have left a user who closed the main window with no update surface at all. The check itself is throttled through the shared `lastCheckedAt` in localStorage, so N windows still cost one check.
